title: High resolution porewater profiling of methylmercury with a novel equilibrium passive sampler
content:
Environ. Sci.: Adv., 2026, 5,1070-1080
DOI: 10.1039/D5VA00492F, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Jada C. Damond, Cynthia C. Gilmour, Upal Ghosh
A novel, equilibrium-based passive sampler (PS) provided fine-scale porewater MeHg profiles in both freshwater and estuarine microcosms. The PS located the peak and provided highly resolved (0.5 cm) measurements across the sediment–water interface.
